responsibility: Declares OpenRISC newlib-specific command-line options for the GCC driver, specifically the board-selection option used by the bare-metal runtime configuration and a compatibility -mnewlib switch. The option table feeds generated option handling so linker and runtime specs in the ELF configuration can react to board choices without changing backend code generation logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-table companion to elf.h: unlike elf.h, which hardcodes the bare-metal ELF linker and runtime specs, this file merely declares the newlib driver switches (-mboard= and compatibility -mnewlib) so generated option handling can feed those specs.
